QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_59

question.text: Credit/debit cards issued by which entity are accepted as valid proof of identity for KYC?

explanation.text: The Logic: Credit cards and debit cards issued by Banks appear in the workbook's proof-of-identity list for KYC. The Trap: 'Any financial institution' is too broad; only bank-issued cards are listed, not cards from other financial entities. Note: Bank-issued credit/debit cards are not listed in the proof-of-address category; they are accepted as proof of identity.
